questions: Are you fully conscious and able to respond normally while the hand is jerking?
Can you voluntarily stop the jerking, even briefly, by concentrating or holding the hand still?
Does the jerking continue while you are asleep?
Did it begin suddenly, within seconds or minutes?
Has the jerking spread from the hand to the forearm, arm, face, or another part of the body?
Have you had any weakness, numbness, speech difficulty, or loss of coordination on that side?
Do you experience an unusual sensation in the hand or arm immediately before or during the jerking?
Have you become confused, unusually sleepy, or developed a headache after episodes?
Have you ever had a seizure or a similar episode before?
Have you recently had a stroke, head injury, brain infection, fever, or severe headache?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication, or used alcohol or recreational drugs?
